d:
Is pitripaksh, gaya ji men apne pitron ke nimitt tarpan evan pinddan ki pavitr paranpra ka nirvahan kijie.
Bihar paryatan dvara uplabdh pitripaksh paikej ki buking ab onlain ki ja sakti hai.
Vebsait par jaen, apni suvidhanusar paikej chunen aur die gae charnon ka palan kar aasani se apni buking puri karen.
Buking prakriya janne ke lie vidiyo dekhen aur aaj hi apna pitripaksh paikej buk karen.
